commitResults.messageTitle: chore: add java coding standards skill

commitResults.messageBody: Persist each task-list mutation and restore saved tasks at startup. Create the relative data directory automatically on first use.
Store deadline and event dates as LocalDate. Reject invalid dates and preserve ISO values in task storage.
Move console interaction, command parsing, and task collection operations into focused classes. Keep Ollie responsible for coordinating them.
Place all Java classes under the ollie package while retaining src/main/java as the source root. Update the README path to match the new layout.
Set the application entry point and shadow JAR name so Gradle can build and run the packaged chatbot.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit tests for parser and storage
commitResults.messageBody: Cover command parsing, task-number validation, persistence, missing files, malformed data, and unsupported task types with JUnit 5.

commitResults.messageTitle: Document JAR build and run steps
commitResults.messageBody: Explain how to create the executable Ollie JAR with Gradle and run the distributed artifact from its own folder.
Public production classes and methods lack API documentation. Add concise header comments so their responsibilities and contracts are clear without reading their implementations.

commitResults.messageTitle: Align Java code with coding standard
commitResults.messageBody: Several production lines exceed the preferred width and date-related names are too terse for their scope. Wrap long expressions, use descriptive date names, simplify switch fallthrough, and strengthen task encapsulation.
Future Java changes need a repository-scoped reference to the course rules. Add a focused skill and require it through AGENTS.md so later edits consistently apply the basic and intermediate standard.
Commit and branch conventions need a repository-scoped reference. Add a focused Git skill and require it through AGENTS.md so future history remains consistent with the course standard.

Users cannot locate tasks without scanning the full list. Add case-insensitive keyword search across task descriptions, validate missing keywords, display numbered matches, and cover the behavior with tests.

Coding-standard checks rely on manual review alone. Add the Gradle Checkstyle plugin and the SE-EDU rules so main and test sources are checked automatically during builds.

Provide an FXML chat interface that reuses the existing command logic.

Keep console formatting separate for clean output in both interfaces.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use varargs to format UI messages

commitResults.messageBody:
Task list operations rely on valid zero-based indexes.

Command handling relies on the task list being loaded first.

Violating these internal assumptions indicates a programming error.

Add assertions at these boundaries. Enable them for Gradle runs and tests.

Stored task parsing mixes several responsibilities in one method.

This makes its control flow and file-format assumptions harder to follow.

Extract focused parsers for each task type and status restoration.

Name field positions, counts, type codes, and status values.

The smaller methods keep each operation at one abstraction level.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use streams to find matching tasks
commitResults.messageBody:
Task search manually loops over the list and accumulates matches.

The operation is a direct filter with no mutation or early exit.

Replace the loop with a stream pipeline.

Keep keyword normalization outside the pipeline so it runs only once.
Document internal assumptions with assertions
Refactor storage task parsing
Use streams to find matching tasks

Bot responses and user commands currently share too much visual
structure. This wastes horizontal space and makes errors easy to
overlook.

Use full-width bot cards, compact user bubbles, and dedicated error
styling. Make message widths and window limits responsive so the chat
remains usable at different sizes.

Validate command arguments, dates, task ranges, duplicate tasks, and persisted data before applying changes.

Keep task mutations atomic when storage writes fail, and preserve invalid data files rather than overwriting them. Add regression tests for the new command and storage failure paths.

Ollie's name, responses, and interface lacked a unified personality.

Present Ollie as a calm personal mission controller, with themed
phrases, a compact branded header, and high-contrast signal colors.
Update the README and response tests to keep the experience consistent.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix parsing when assertions are disabled
commitResults.messageBody:
Deadline and event parsing depended on a regex search inside an assert.
With assertions disabled, the search never ran and valid commands
crashed with IllegalStateException.

Perform the search unconditionally and assert only its result so the
packaged app works with Java's default assertion settings.

Document setup, commands, saving, and troubleshooting
so users can manage tasks through Ollie's chat interface.
